column1: # Language guard 2 exemptions: Chinese text in a src/main/java literal that is deliberately not routed
# through the language catalogue. One line per literal, three tab-separated fields:
#   path (relative to the module root) <TAB> the literal exactly as written between its quotes <TAB> reason
# Every line needs a reason. A line that no longer matches a literal fails the build (UltiRemoteBagCjkLiteralScopeTest).

column2: 背包锁的回收超时时间（秒）。仅用于回收持有者会话异常结束而未释放的锁；
column3: Part of the bilingual comment master wrote above lock.timeout_seconds from bd168a2 to 4cac234 (English, then Chinese), registered as @ConfigEntry(previousComments) so the framework recognises it as its own on an upgraded server and rewrites it in the server's language (UltiKits/UltiRemoteBag#52; maintainer decision 2026-10-04, UltiKits/UltiTools-Reborn#611). It is never written to a file and never shown to a player: the comment the framework writes comes from the language file
